verses.greek: Ὁ οὖν Ἰησοῦς πρὸ ἓξ ἡμερῶν τοῦ πάσχα ἦλθεν εἰς Βηθανίαν, ὅπου ἦν Λάζαρος, ὃν ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν Ἰησοῦς.
verses.literal: the Therefore Jesus before six days the Passover came to Bethany where was Lazarus who raised out from the dead Jesus.
verses.dgt: So Jesus, six days before the Passover, came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.

verses.greek: ἐποίησαν οὖν αὐτῷ δεῖπνον ἐκεῖ, καὶ ἡ Μάρθα διηκόνει, ὁ δὲ Λάζαρος εἷς ἦν ἐκ τῶν ἀνακειμένων σὺν αὐτῷ·
verses.literal: They made therefore for Him a supper there and the Martha was serving the and Lazarus one was of those reclining with Him.
verses.dgt: So they made a dinner for him there, and Martha was serving, while Lazarus was one of those reclining with him.

verses.greek: ἡ οὖν Μαριὰμ λαβοῦσα λίτραν μύρου νάρδου πιστικῆς πολυτίμου ἤλειψεν τοὺς πόδας τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἐξέμαξεν ταῖς θριξὶν αὐτῆς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ· ἡ δὲ οἰκία ἐπληρώθη ἐκ τῆς ὀσμῆς τοῦ μύρου.
verses.literal: the Therefore Mary having taken a litra of fragrant oil of nard pure of great price anointed the feet the of Jesus and wiped with the hair of her the feet of Him the now house was filled with the fragrance of the oil.
verses.dgt: Then Mary took a pound of very costly fragrant oil of pure nard, anointed Jesus’ feet, and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the oil.

verses.greek: λέγει δὲ Ἰούδας ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης εἷς τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ, ὁ μέλλων αὐτὸν παραδιδόναι·
verses.literal: Says however Judas the Iscariot one the disciples of Him who is being about Him to betray
verses.dgt: But Judas Iscariot, one of his disciples, the one who was going to betray him, says,

verses.greek: Διὰ τί τοῦτο τὸ μύρον οὐκ ἐπράθη τριακοσίων δηναρίων καὶ ἐδόθη πτωχοῖς;
verses.literal: Because of why this the fragrant oil not was sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?
verses.dgt: “Why was this fragrant oil not sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”

verses.greek: εἶπεν δὲ τοῦτο οὐχ ὅτι περὶ τῶν πτωχῶν ἔμελεν αὐτῷ, ἀλλʼ ὅτι κλέπτης ἦν καὶ τὸ γλωσσόκομον ἔχων τὰ βαλλόμενα ἐβάσταζεν.
verses.literal: He said however this not because for the poor he was caring to him but because a thief he was and the money bag having that being put into it he was pilfering.
verses.dgt: He said this not because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, he used to take what was put into it.

verses.greek: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἄφες αὐτήν, ἵνα εἰς τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ ἐνταφιασμοῦ μου τηρήσῃ αὐτό·
verses.literal: Said therefore the Jesus do leave alone her so that for the day of the burial of Mine she may keep it
verses.dgt: So Jesus said, “Leave her alone, so that she may keep it for the day of my burial.

verses.greek: τοὺς πτωχοὺς γὰρ πάντοτε ἔχετε μεθʼ ἑαυτῶν, ἐμὲ δὲ οὐ πάντοτε ἔχετε.
verses.literal: the poor for always you have with yourselves Me myself however not always you have.
verses.dgt: For you always have the poor with you, but you do not always have me.”

verses.greek: Ἔγνω οὖν ὄχλος πολὺς ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἐστιν, καὶ ἦλθον οὐ διὰ τὸν Ἰησοῦν μόνον, ἀλλʼ ἵνα καὶ τὸν Λάζαρον ἴδωσιν ὃν ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν.
verses.literal: Knew therefore a crowd great of the Jews that there He is and they came not because of the Jesus only but that also the Lazarus they may see whom He had raised out from the dead.
verses.dgt: Then a large crowd of the Jews learned that he was there, and they came not because of Jesus only, but also so that they might see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.

verses.greek: ἐβουλεύσαντο δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἵνα καὶ τὸν Λάζαρον ἀποκτείνωσιν,
verses.literal: Took counsel however the chief priests that also the Lazarus they may kill
verses.dgt: But the chief priests planned to kill Lazarus also,

verses.greek: ὅτι πολλοὶ διʼ αὐτὸν ὑπῆγον τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ ἐπίστευον εἰς τὸν Ἰησοῦν.
verses.literal: because many on account of him were going away of the Jews and were believing in the Jesus.
verses.dgt: because on account of him many of the Jews were going away and believing in Jesus.

verses.greek: Τῇ ἐπαύριον ὁ ὄχλος πολὺς ὁ ἐλθὼν εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν, ἀκούσαντες ὅτι ἔρχεται ⸁ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα,
verses.literal: On the next day the crowd great the having come to the feast having heard that is coming the Jesus into Jerusalem
verses.dgt: The next day the large crowd that had come to the feast, hearing that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

verses.greek: ἔλαβον τὰ βαΐα τῶν φοινίκων καὶ ἐξῆλθον εἰς ὑπάντησιν αὐτῷ, καὶ ἐκραύγαζον· Ὡσαννά, εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου, καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.
verses.literal: took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet Him and were shouting: Hosanna! Blessed is the One coming in the name of the Lord! And the King the of Israel!
verses.dgt: took branches of palm trees and went out to meet him, and they were crying out, “Hosanna! Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord, even the King of Israel!”

verses.greek: εὑρὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὀνάριον ἐκάθισεν ἐπʼ αὐτό, καθώς ἐστιν γεγραμμένον·
verses.literal: Having found then the Jesus a young donkey He sat upon it even as it is written:
verses.dgt: And Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it, just as it is written,

verses.greek: Μὴ φοβοῦ, θυγάτηρ Σιών· ἰδοὺ ὁ βασιλεύς σου ἔρχεται, καθήμενος ἐπὶ πῶλον ὄνου.
verses.literal: Not do fear daughter of Zion Behold the King of you comes sitting on a colt of a donkey.
verses.dgt: “Do not be afraid, daughter of Zion. Look, your King is coming, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”

verses.greek: ταῦτα οὐκ ἔγνωσαν αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ τὸ πρῶτον, ἀλλʼ ὅτε ἐδοξάσθη Ἰησοῦς τότε ἐμνήσθησαν ὅτι ταῦτα ἦν ἐπʼ αὐτῷ γεγραμμένα καὶ ταῦτα ἐποίησαν αὐτῷ.
verses.literal: These things not knew of Him the disciples from the first but when was glorified Jesus then they remembered that these things were about Him written and these things they had done to Him.
verses.dgt: His disciples did not understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things had been written about him and that they had done these things to him.

verses.greek: ἐμαρτύρει οὖν ὁ ὄχλος ὁ ὢν μετʼ αὐτοῦ ὅτε τὸν Λάζαρον ἐφώνησεν ἐκ τοῦ μνημείου καὶ ἤγειρεν αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν.
verses.literal: was bearing witness therefore the crowd which is being with Him when the Lazarus He called out of the tomb and raised him out from the dead.
verses.dgt: So the crowd that had been with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was bearing witness.

verses.greek: διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ὑπήντησεν αὐτῷ ὁ ὄχλος ὅτι ἤκουσαν τοῦτο αὐτὸν πεποιηκέναι τὸ σημεῖον.
verses.literal: On account of this also met with Him the crowd because they heard this of His to have done the sign.
verses.dgt: For this reason the crowd also went to meet him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

verses.greek: οἱ οὖν Φαρισαῖοι εἶπαν πρὸς ἑαυτούς· Θεωρεῖτε ὅτι οὐκ ὠφελεῖτε οὐδέν· ἴδε ὁ κόσμος ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθεν.
verses.literal: the Therefore the Pharisees said among themselves You see that not you gain no thing? Behold the world after Him has gone.
verses.dgt: So the Pharisees said to one another, “You see that you are gaining nothing. Look, the world has gone after him.”

verses.greek: Ἦσαν δὲ Ἕλληνές τινες ἐκ τῶν ἀναβαινόντων ἵνα προσκυνήσωσιν ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ·
verses.literal: There were now Greeks certain among those coming up that they may worship at the feast.
verses.dgt: Now there were some Greeks among those going up to worship at the feast.

verses.greek: οὗτοι οὖν προσῆλθον Φιλίππῳ τῷ ἀπὸ Βηθσαϊδὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας, καὶ ἠρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες· Κύριε, θέλομεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἰδεῖν.
verses.literal: these therefore came to Philip who was from Bethsaida the of Galilee and they were asking him saying Sir we desire the Jesus to see.
verses.dgt: So these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and were asking him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”

verses.greek: ἔρχεται ὁ Φίλιππος καὶ λέγει τῷ Ἀνδρέᾳ· ἔρχεται Ἀνδρέας καὶ Φίλιππος καὶ λέγουσιν τῷ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.literal: Comes the Philip and tells the Andrew come Andrew and Philip and they tell the Jesus.
verses.dgt: Philip comes and tells Andrew; Andrew and Philip come and tell Jesus.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἀποκρίνεται αὐτοῖς λέγων· Ἐλήλυθεν ἡ ὥρα ἵνα δοξασθῇ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.
verses.literal: the And Jesus answered to them saying Has come the hour that may be glorified the Son the of Man.
verses.dgt: But Jesus answers them, saying, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

verses.greek: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν μὴ ὁ κόκκος τοῦ σίτου πεσὼν εἰς τὴν γῆν ἀποθάνῃ, αὐτὸς μόνος μένει· ἐὰν δὲ ἀποθάνῃ, πολὺν καρπὸν φέρει.
verses.literal: Amen Amen I say to you only unless the grain the of wheat having fallen into the ground shall die it alone abides if however it shall die much fruit it bears.
verses.dgt: Truly, truly, I say to you: unless a grain of wheat falls into the ground and dies, it remains alone; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.

verses.greek: ὁ φιλῶν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἀπολλύει αὐτήν, καὶ ὁ μισῶν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ τούτῳ εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον φυλάξει αὐτήν.
verses.literal: The one loving the life of him loses it and the one hating the life of him in the world this to life eternal will keep it.
verses.dgt: The one who loves his life loses it, and the one who hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.

verses.greek: ἐὰν ἐμοί τις διακονῇ ἐμοὶ ἀκολουθείτω, καὶ ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ἐκεῖ καὶ ὁ διάκονος ὁ ἐμὸς ἔσται· ἐάν τις ἐμοὶ διακονῇ τιμήσει αὐτὸν ὁ πατήρ.
verses.literal: If Me myself anyone shall serve Me myself he should follow and where am I myself there also the servant the of Mine will be. If anyone Me myself shall serve will honor him the Father.
verses.dgt: If anyone serves me, let him follow me; and where I am, there my servant will be also. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

verses.greek: Νῦν ἡ ψυχή μου τετάρακται, καὶ τί εἴπω; πάτερ, σῶσόν με ἐκ τῆς ὥρας ταύτης. ἀλλὰ διὰ τοῦτο ἦλθον εἰς τὴν ὥραν ταύτην.
verses.literal: Now the soul of Mine has been troubled and what shall I say? Father do save Me from the hour this.’? But on account of this I came to the hour this.
verses.dgt: Now my soul is troubled, and what should I say? ‘Father, save me from this hour’? But for this reason I came to this hour.

verses.greek: πάτερ, δόξασόν σου τὸ ὄνομα. ἦλθεν οὖν φωνὴ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ· Καὶ ἐδόξασα καὶ πάλιν δοξάσω.
verses.literal: Father do glorify of You the name. Came therefore a voice from the heaven: Both I have glorified it and again I will glorify it.
verses.dgt: Father, glorify your name.” Then a voice came from heaven: “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”

verses.greek: ὁ οὖν ὄχλος ὁ ἑστὼς καὶ ἀκούσας ἔλεγεν βροντὴν γεγονέναι· ἄλλοι ἔλεγον· Ἄγγελος αὐτῷ λελάληκεν.
verses.literal: the Therefore the crowd which already standing and having heard it it was saying it Thunder to have been. Others were saying An angel to Him has spoken.
verses.dgt: So the crowd standing there and hearing it was saying that thunder had happened. Others were saying, “An angel has spoken to him.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν· Οὐ διʼ ἐμὲ ἡ φωνὴ αὕτη γέγονεν ἀλλὰ διʼ ὑμᾶς.
verses.literal: Answered Jesus and said: Not because of Me myself the voice this has come but because of you.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered and said, “This voice has come not for my sake, but for yours.

verses.greek: νῦν κρίσις ἐστὶν τοῦ κόσμου τούτου, νῦν ὁ ἄρχων τοῦ κόσμου τούτου ἐκβληθήσεται ἔξω·
verses.literal: Now the judgment is of the world of this now the prince of the world this will be cast out
verses.dgt: Now is the judgment of this world; now the ruler of this world will be cast out.

verses.greek: κἀγὼ ἐὰν ὑψωθῶ ἐκ τῆς γῆς, πάντας ἑλκύσω πρὸς ἐμαυτόν.
verses.literal: And I myself if I shall be lifted up from the earth all will draw to Myself.
verses.dgt: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to myself.”

verses.greek: τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγεν σημαίνων ποίῳ θανάτῳ ἤμελλεν ἀποθνῄσκειν.
verses.literal: This now He was saying signifying by what death He was about to die.
verses.dgt: He was saying this to indicate by what kind of death he was going to die.

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ ὄχλος· Ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν ἐκ τοῦ νόμου ὅτι ὁ χριστὸς μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καὶ πῶς λέγεις σὺ ὅτι δεῖ ὑψωθῆναι τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου; τίς ἐστιν οὗτος ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου;
verses.literal: Answered therefore to Him the crowd We ourselves heard from the law that the Christ abides to the age and how say you yourself that it behooves to be lifted up the Son the of Man? Who is this the Son the of Man?
verses.dgt: So the crowd answered him, “We heard from the Law that the Christ remains forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”

verses.greek: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἔτι μικρὸν χρόνον τὸ φῶς ἐν ὑμῖν ἐστιν. περιπατεῖτε ὡς τὸ φῶς ἔχετε, ἵνα μὴ σκοτία ὑμᾶς καταλάβῃ, καὶ ὁ περιπατῶν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ οὐκ οἶδεν ποῦ ὑπάγει.
verses.literal: Said therefore to them the Jesus Yet a little while the light among you is. do walk while the light you have so that not darkness you may grasp And the one walking in the darkness not knows where he is going.
verses.dgt: So Jesus said to them, “The light is among you for a little while longer. Walk while you have the light, so that darkness may not overtake you. The one who walks in darkness does not know where he is going.

verses.greek: ὡς τὸ φῶς ἔχετε, πιστεύετε εἰς τὸ φῶς, ἵνα υἱοὶ φωτὸς γένησθε. Ταῦτα ἐλάλησεν Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἀπελθὼν ἐκρύβη ἀπʼ αὐτῶν.
verses.literal: While the light you have do believe in the light so that sons of light you may become. These things spoke Jesus and having gone away He was hidden from them.
verses.dgt: While you have the light, believe in the light, so that you may become sons of light.” Jesus said these things, and after going away he hid himself from them.

verses.greek: τοσαῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ σημεῖα πεποιηκότος ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐπίστευον εἰς αὐτόν,
verses.literal: So many however of Him signs having been done before them not they were believing in Him
verses.dgt: But though he had done so many signs before them, they were not believing in him,

verses.greek: ἵνα ὁ λόγος Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου πληρωθῇ ὃν εἶπεν· Κύριε, τίς ἐπίστευσεν τῇ ἀκοῇ ἡμῶν; καὶ ὁ βραχίων κυρίου τίνι ἀπεκαλύφθη;
verses.literal: so that the word of Isaiah the prophet may be fulfilled that said: Lord who has believed in the report of us? And the arm of the Lord to whom has been revealed?
verses.dgt: so that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he said: “Lord, who has believed our report? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

verses.greek: διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἠδύναντο πιστεύειν ὅτι πάλιν εἶπεν Ἠσαΐας·
verses.literal: Because of this not they were able to believe for again said Isaiah:
verses.dgt: For this reason they were unable to believe, because Isaiah said again,

verses.greek: Τετύφλωκεν αὐτῶν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς καὶ ἐπώρωσεν αὐτῶν τὴν καρδίαν, ἵνα μὴ ἴδωσιν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς καὶ νοήσωσιν τῇ καρδίᾳ καὶ στραφῶσιν, καὶ ἰάσομαι αὐτούς.
verses.literal: He has blinded of them the eyes and has hardened of them the heart that not they may see with the eyes and may understand with the heart and may turn and I will heal them.
verses.dgt: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their heart, so that they might not see with their eyes and understand with their heart and turn, and I would heal them.”

verses.greek: ταῦτα εἶπεν Ἠσαΐας ὅτι εἶδεν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐλάλησεν περὶ αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: These things said Isaiah because he saw the glory of Him and spoke concerning Him.
verses.dgt: Isaiah said these things because he saw his glory and spoke about him.

verses.greek: ὅμως μέντοι καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀρχόντων πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν, ἀλλὰ διὰ τοὺς Φαρισαίους οὐχ ὡμολόγουν ἵνα μὴ ἀποσυνάγωγοι γένωνται,
verses.literal: Nevertheless indeed even of the rulers many believed in Him but on account of the Pharisees not they were confessing so that not put out of the synagogue they may be.
verses.dgt: Nevertheless, even among the rulers many believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they were not confessing it, so that they would not be put out of the synagogue,

verses.greek: ἠγάπησαν γὰρ τὴν δόξαν τῶν ἀνθρώπων μᾶλλον ἤπερ τὴν δόξαν τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.literal: they loved for the glory the of men more than the glory the of God.
verses.dgt: for they loved the glory of men more than the glory of God.

verses.greek: Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἔκραξεν καὶ εἶπεν· Ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ πιστεύει εἰς ἐμὲ ἀλλὰ εἰς τὸν πέμψαντά με,
verses.literal: Jesus then cried out and said The one believing in Me myself not he believes in Me myself but in the One having sent Me
verses.dgt: But Jesus cried out and said, “The one who believes in me does not believe in me only, but in the one who sent me,

verses.greek: καὶ ὁ θεωρῶν ἐμὲ θεωρεῖ τὸν πέμψαντά με.
verses.literal: and the one beholding Me myself he beholds the One having sent Me.
verses.dgt: and the one who sees me sees the one who sent me.

verses.greek: ἐγὼ φῶς εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἐλήλυθα, ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ μὴ μείνῃ.
verses.literal: I myself a light into the world have come so that everyone who is believing in Me myself in the darkness not may abide.
verses.dgt: I have come into the world as light, so that everyone who believes in me may not remain in darkness.

verses.greek: καὶ ἐάν τίς μου ἀκούσῃ τῶν ῥημάτων καὶ μὴ φυλάξῃ, ἐγὼ οὐ κρίνω αὐτόν, οὐ γὰρ ἦλθον ἵνα κρίνω τὸν κόσμον ἀλλʼ ἵνα σώσω τὸν κόσμον.
verses.literal: And if anyone My shall hear the declarations and not shall keep them I myself not do judge him not for I came that I may judge the world but that I may save the world.
verses.dgt: And if anyone hears my words and does not keep them, I do not judge him, for I did not come to judge the world but to save the world.

verses.greek: ὁ ἀθετῶν ἐμὲ καὶ μὴ λαμβάνων τὰ ῥήματά μου ἔχει τὸν κρίνοντα αὐτόν· ὁ λόγος ὃν ἐλάλησα ἐκεῖνος κρινεῖ αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ·
verses.literal: The one rejecting Me myself and not receiving the declarations of Mine has one judging him: The word which I spoke that one will judge him in the last day.
verses.dgt: The one who rejects me and does not receive my words has one who judges him: the word that I spoke will judge him on the last day.

verses.greek: ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐξ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐκ ἐλάλησα, ἀλλʼ ὁ πέμψας με πατὴρ αὐτός μοι ἐντολὴν δέδωκεν τί εἴπω καὶ τί λαλήσω.
verses.literal: For I myself from Myself not spoke but the having sent Me Father Himself Me a commandment has given what I may say and what I may speak.
verses.dgt: For I did not speak from myself, but the Father who sent me himself gave me a command as to what I should say and what I should speak.

verses.greek: καὶ οἶδα ὅτι ἡ ἐντολὴ αὐτοῦ ζωὴ αἰώνιός ἐστιν. ἃ οὖν ἐγὼ λαλῶ, καθὼς εἴρηκέν μοι ὁ πατήρ, οὕτως λαλῶ.
verses.literal: And I know that the commandment of Him life eternal is. What therefore I myself speak even as has said to Me the Father so I speak.
verses.dgt: And I know that his command is eternal life. Therefore the things I speak, I speak just as the Father has told me.”
